summary: Xunlei Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. No new corporate event, transaction, or strategic action is announced. This is a routine earnings release under a foreign private issuer report (6-K), equivalent to a current report on Form 8-K for US issuers. Trust the conservative default: no special situation is present.
